function.name: search_help_center
function.description: Search Lumen's help center articles for how-to answers. Use for questions about how a feature works.

function.name: get_invoice
function.description: Fetch an invoice by month or invoice number, with line items and payment status.

function.name: refund_charge
function.description: Refund a card charge in full or in part. Only after the customer asked for money back.

function.name: send_password_reset
function.description: Email a password reset link to the account's address.

function.name: file_bug_report
function.description: Open a bug report for the engineering team when something in the product is broken. Include steps to reproduce.

function.name: handoff_to_agent
function.description: Hand the conversation to a person on the support team. Use when the customer asks for a person or is upset.
